title: Best Dog Food (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from the 2026 air‑dried dog food test on Health Extension and the 2026 UK dog food rankings on Smart Bark. The best pick is the one that appears as the top score in more than one source.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so cost comparisons are based on relative value statements only.
